## 🎯 Objective
Implement robust smart waiting strategy using FluentWait with configurable timeouts, polling intervals, and multiple wait conditions to handle dynamic content loading and reduce test flakiness.

## 📋 Tasks
- [ ] Create `WaitUtils.java` utility class with FluentWait implementation
- [ ] Implement smart wait conditions (visibility, clickability, presence, text, etc.)
- [ ] Add page load and AJAX completion wait methods
- [ ] Integrate WaitUtils with BasePage and BaseTest classes
- [ ] Add wait configuration to config.properties
- [ ] Update Configuration.java with wait-specific methods
- [ ] Enhance TextBoxPage with smart waiting usage
- [ ] Verify backward compatibility with existing tests
- [ ] Test wait utilities across different scenarios
- [ ] Update documentation and README

---

## 🔧 Technical Details
### Smart Waiting Strategy Architecture
```java
WaitUtils (Core Utility)
├── FluentWait with configurable timeout/polling
├── Multiple wait conditions:
│   ├── Element presence & visibility
│   ├── Element clickability
│   ├── Text presence in elements
│   ├── Element invisibility
│   ├── Page load completion
│   ├── AJAX calls completion
│   └── Custom conditions
└── Exception handling with meaningful messages
```

### Configuration Structure
```properties
# Wait Configuration
wait.polling.interval=500        # Polling interval in milliseconds
wait.fluent.timeout=30           # Maximum wait timeout in seconds
wait.ajax.timeout=10             # AJAX specific timeout
```

### Integration Points
- **BasePage:** Enhanced with smart wait methods
- **BaseTest:** WaitUtils instance available for tests
- Configuration: Centralized wait configuration management
- Existing Pages: Backward compatible with optional smart wait usage

### ✅ Acceptance Criteria
- WaitUtils provides comprehensive waiting strategies
- All wait methods are configurable via properties
- Proper exception handling with meaningful error messages
- Backward compatibility maintained with existing WebDriverWait
- Reduced test flakiness through smart waiting
- Comprehensive logging for wait operations
- All existing tests pass successfully
- CI/CD pipeline remains stable
